Gold.note: Strong central bank buying and safe-haven demand support elevated prices.

Silver.note: Robust photovoltaic demand and structural deficits drive bullish momentum.

Copper.note: Tight concentrate markets and green energy transition underpin steady demand.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficits and renewed global nuclear capacity additions.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply and moderating EV growth rates weigh on pricing.

Nickel.note: Surging Indonesian supply and LFP battery substitution limit upside.

Zinc.note: Mine supply constraints offset by sluggish galvanized steel demand.

Iron Ore.note: Ongoing weakness in Chinese real estate construction suppresses steel demand.

Coal.note: Adequate global inventories and seasonal demand normalization cap upside.

Rare Earths.note: Strategic supply chain shifts and steady EV motor demand provide support.

Manganese.note: Soft steel production in China limits near-term demand growth.

PGM.note: Substitution effects and weak auto production offset long-term hydrogen potential.

Potash.note: Balanced global supply and steady agricultural application rates.

Aluminum.note: Tight primary supply and strong solar and automotive sector demand.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to copper and iron ore offsets sector-specific volatility.
